title: Frozen Provider Diagnostic Postmortem and Independent Offline Responsibility Adjudication

semantic_field_rules.concise_rationale: The synthetic input explicitly identifies the other person as a workplace senior, so unknown loses a directly stated hierarchy relation.
semantic_field_rules.product_behavior_impact: A missed hierarchy signal can produce an inappropriately casual or assertive reply.
semantic_field_rules.chatgpt_recommendation: Require explicit Japanese role terms such as workplace senior or junior to populate the bounded hierarchy value without inventing authority beyond the text.
semantic_field_rules.prompt_correction_candidate: Clarify that an explicitly stated workplace senior establishes user_is_junior while the work_or_school chip alone does not.

semantic_field_rules.concise_rationale: The user explicitly says the current delay is ordinary relative to the stated usual cadence, so unknown discards direct evidence.
semantic_field_rules.product_behavior_impact: Losing the ordinary-cadence signal can amplify anxiety and overstate the need for action.
semantic_field_rules.chatgpt_recommendation: Treat an explicit user statement that the delay is ordinary as within_usual even when exact elapsed minutes remain unresolved.
semantic_field_rules.prompt_correction_candidate: Separate the qualitative cadence relation from the exact elapsed-time field and preserve explicit ordinary-cadence statements.

semantic_field_rules.concise_rationale: The Candidate both provides Saturday availability and asks for the time; provide_information is Schema-valid and the Prompt does not require confirm_schedule for this wording.
semantic_field_rules.product_behavior_impact: A narrow label contract can trigger unnecessary rewrites even when the Candidate's practical intent is preserved.
semantic_field_rules.chatgpt_recommendation: Accept provide_information, confirm_schedule, or both for this wording unless Product Owner defines a stricter multi-label rule.
semantic_field_rules.prompt_correction_candidate: Define when availability plus a request for time is provide_information, confirm_schedule, or a multi-label combination.

semantic_field_rules.concise_rationale: The Candidate directly asks the recipient to provide the meeting time, while the Prompt requires every directly supported contact-action signal.
semantic_field_rules.product_behavior_impact: Missing asks_for_reply weakens later boundary-aware contact routing when Base facts are combined.
semantic_field_rules.chatgpt_recommendation: Count a direct request to provide meeting details as asks_for_reply in addition to proposes_meeting, subject to Product Owner confirmation of the trigger boundary.
semantic_field_rules.prompt_correction_candidate: Define whether ordinary requests for requested information count as asks_for_reply and distinguish them from reply_demand.

semantic_field_rules.concise_rationale: A single unmodified casual apology can reasonably be low strength; the separate same-day request already captures response pressure.
semantic_field_rules.product_behavior_impact: Conflating apology presence with apology intensity can exaggerate the Candidate's emotional temperature.
semantic_field_rules.chatgpt_recommendation: Allow low for a single casual apology unless repetition, intensifiers, self-blame, or repair language raises the strength.
semantic_field_rules.prompt_correction_candidate: Define apology strength independently from response pressure and list bounded intensity signals.

semantic_field_rules.concise_rationale: Two predicate endings use desu or masu politeness, so classifying the whole three-sentence Candidate as casual is not supported; neutral_polite is already allowed.
semantic_field_rules.product_behavior_impact: A casual misclassification can cause the final draft to flatten a deliberate closure tone.
semantic_field_rules.chatgpt_recommendation: Treat dominant desu or masu endings as neutral_polite unless clearly offset by sustained casual endings; reserve mixed for a genuinely balanced register split.
semantic_field_rules.prompt_correction_candidate: Define message-level register aggregation for mixed lexical warmth and polite predicate endings.
